prompt:
ONE image divided into 3 CLEAR PANELS of equal size, arranged left to right in a horizontal row, separated by generous clean cream gutters with NO drawn borders and NO frame lines. Each panel is one beat of the same argument and they read in order.

BEAT ONE: He slides one handwritten page into a slot in the side of the laptop. Inside, a small agent figure produces a plain, crude little object. BEAT TWO: The slot now holds a thick stack of pages. The object the agent is producing is visibly finer and larger than before. BEAT THREE: The agent inside is now writing new pages itself and adding them to the stack while producing an even finer object. He has stepped back with his hands in his pockets, not writing.

THE FIGURE, the same person in all three panels and recognizably the same person in each: a man in his thirties, East Asian, short black hair, wearing a grey knit vest over a rolled-sleeve shirt.

THE SETTING, one consistent world across all three panels: a warm workshop at dusk with a wooden bench. An open glowing translucent amber laptop sits on the bench. The agents and their work live INSIDE the laptop screen; the human works in the warm real room OUTSIDE it.

TEXT FURNITURE, in the cream margins only and never over the artwork. Reproduce every string character-exact and add no other lettering anywhere:
Title bar, centered in the cream margin ABOVE the panels, in caps: COMPOUNDING DOCS
Caption in the cream gutter UNDER panel one, in caps: ONE PAGE IN
Caption in the cream gutter UNDER panel two, in caps: THE STACK GROWS
Caption in the cream gutter UNDER panel three, in caps: IT WRITES ITS OWN
Footer bar, centered in the cream margin BELOW the panels, in caps: EACH PAGE MAKES THE NEXT ONE FASTER

Any other writable surface in frame is BLANK: no labels, no writing on the bench, no text on the laptop screen, no numbers anywhere.

ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual. No neon, no 3D or CGI rendering, no glossy plastic, no HUD or arc-reactor comic vocabulary, no power armor, no robot suits.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.
